exposure: Implementation of 10-group Robson classification reporting and medical audit
10-group Robson classification for delivery ward clinical management
Implementation of recommendations for cesarean section
cohort: All women who gave birth in a specific hospital in the years 2001, 2006, and 2010
finding: Implementation of recommendations for cesarean section led to a significant reduction of cesarean section subrates in lower-risk groups, while 10-group Robson classification monitoring helped stabilize the overall cesarean section rate.
